## Summary

Describe the WRF-Hydro build, diagnostic, documentation, or test change.

## Verification

- [ ] `python -m compileall src tests -q`
- [ ] `python -m pytest`
- [ ] Generated shell scripts pass `bash -n`
- [ ] Real build/run verification was performed, or the limitation is documented

## Safety and scope

- [ ] No source archives, build products, credentials, licenses, or private paths are included
- [ ] Existing WRF/WPS/WRF-Hydro environments are not modified unexpectedly
- [ ] Documentation and verification status match the actual evidence
